02 / THE PITCH PLAYBOOK

BUILD
YOUR CASE.

A pitch is a clear argument for an idea.
Give each part a reason to be there.

01 / 04THE OPPORTUNITY

The problem.

Start with a real need. Show who experiences it and why the existing options fall short.

02 / 04THE MARKET

The customer.

Make your audience specific. Explain who would use your solution and why it would matter to them.

03 / 04THE MODEL

The business.

Connect the idea to a practical model. Explain what you offer, how it creates value, and what makes it different.

04 / 04THE ASK

The next step.

Show what you have learned so far. Explain what you need next and what it would help you achieve.

Preparation guidance only. The official pitch format, time limit, and judging criteria will be announced with the competition rules.

03 / BEFORE YOU ENTER

KNOW YOUR
ARENA.

The essentials, as they’re announced.

What is the prize pool?+

Startup Smackdown has a ₹40,000 prize pool: ₹20,000 for first place, ₹12,000 for second, and ₹8,000 for third.

What is Startup Smackdown?+

Startup Smackdown is the Business Pitching Competition at Elevate 3.0, where participants develop and present their business ideas.

Can I pitch an early-stage idea?+

The permitted idea stages, eligibility criteria, and team rules will be confirmed in the official participation guidelines.

How long is the pitch, and what will judges look for?+

Pitch duration, deck requirements, judging criteria, and the competition format are being finalized. Confirmed details will be published here.

When does registration open?+

The registration date, entry requirements, and sign-up link will be announced here. No applications are being collected yet.
